description:
Deferrals recorded by the P3/P4 port agents, each documented in-file at the point
it applies. Collected here so they are not lost:

- Isotropic cracking (nCracks / sliceMapper / lhgr crack-softening) on the UO2,
  MOX and SCK-CEN Young's-modulus and UO2/MOX Poisson models. Needs damage-model
  state and a slice mapper, so not a pure function of MaterialState. All variants
  currently return the upstream nominal value.
- Transversely isotropic PyC: upstream itself returns the isotropic average
  (E_r + 2 E_t)/3 with a TODO. Real anisotropy needs a direction-dependent
  modulus in the mechanics layer.
- PARFUMEPyC thermal-expansion spherical-to-Cartesian tensor rotation: upstream
  does it in correct() using mesh_.C()[cellI]; it is a mesh operation and belongs
  in the mechanics assembly.
- swellingPARFUMEBuffer / swellingPARFUMEPyC: they integrate eps += rate*flux*dt,
  so they need fast flux and the timestep, plus a 2-D table interpolator in
  temperature x Bacon Anisotropy Factor and a 1-D one in coating density.
- burnupLassmann / burnupLassmannFBR (~75 KB): TUBRNP-style radial depletion
  solving a reduced Bateman chain for ~14 nuclides plus radial power
  reconstruction. That is neutronics and needs a flux solution.
- Axial-shape half of timeDependentAxialProfile: needs a mesh, pin direction and
  the profiles/ library.
- Relocation recovery (recoveryFraction/relaxRecovery), slice averaging, the
  max/min ratchets and the sensitivity scaling: history/mesh/contact logic.
- SCIANTIX physics: returns NotImplemented, never a silent zero. Separate
  MIT-licensed code with its own licence-provenance and V&V obligations.

Most of these are blocked on the same two things: the damage model and the
slice mapper. Worth sequencing them behind those rather than picking them off.
title: offbeat: deferred sub-models from the P3/P4 port (cracking, PyC anisotropy, PARFUME swelling, Lassmann burnup, relocation recovery)

description: The GPU compute path (src/gpu.rs) was developed headless (no adapter) and is unverified. Run kernel_release_fraction_best_effort on a GPU-equipped host and confirm the f32 kernel agrees with the CPU rayon reference (and Crank) within tolerance. Follows the pflotran op-v6s.14 GPU-unverified pattern.
title: Validate wgpu Walk-on-Spheres dispatch on a real GPU host
